LESSON: DUA (SUPPLICATION WHEN TRAVELLING)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.3: Dua (Supplication when travelling)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Dua (Supplication when travelling), part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to recite a dua while travelling? 2. What safety precautions should one observe while travelling?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read the dua: “Glory to Him who has brought this (e.g. vehicle) under our control, though we were unable to control it (ourselves), and indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.” (Muslim),

2. note the dua in the books and memorise,

3. role-play travelling and recite the dua in class,

4. discuss safe practices a passenger should observe while in a vehicle (such as boarding through door, be seated

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read the dua: “Glory to Him who has brought this (e.g. vehicle) under our control, though we were unable to control it (ourselves), and indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.” (Muslim),
2. note the dua in the books and memorise,
3. role-play travelling and recite the dua in class,
4. discuss safe practices a passenger should observe while in a vehicle (such as boarding through door, be seated

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Dua (Supplication when travelling) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills developed as learners recite the dua

for travelling and note it in their books.

• Creativity and Imagination: there is originality as learners write the dua for travelling on charts.

Values:
Responsibility: accountability is achieved as learners discuss the importance of reciting the dua when travelling and make notes

and class presentation.

PCIs:

Life skills: there is effective communication as learners make classroom presentations.
